audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits: Hwei is immobile with two-cast combos, Talon dictates trades all game; 51.05% WR and Talon x7 packet chart agree, both layers consistent.
Spikes grounded: lvl 3-5 trade window, lvl 6 R, Dirk/Youmuu first item, late Zhonya's/zoning caution. Chart agrees across layers and packet — no chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Hwei's CC ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' in nine fields — the real E is Subject: Torment (packet defect confirms no real Hwei ability name appears). spikes[1] calls Talon's R 'Shadow Assassin' — it is Shadow Assault (packet suspectNames). breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Kit: E Subject: Torment 12s rank 1 carries his hardCC palette; W Subject: Serenity 18s carries shield/utility; R Spiraling Despair 120s. Talon R is Shadow Assault, 100/80/60.
audit.corrected: Fabricated name replaced with Subject: Torment in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[5], report[9]; Shadow Assault fixed in spikes[1]; cooldowns field carries 12s/18s/120s/100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No durations in the cooldowns field.

edits.before: Bleed the lane or leave it — either way the map pays Noxian rates. Track Subject: Fear (CC Paints) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.
edits.after: Bleed the lane or leave it — either way the map pays Noxian rates. Track Subject: Torment (his CC palette) before every commit and keep the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment's fear or root, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.

edits.before: - Talon vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Stand where the rake's return doubles — geometry is the poke. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.
edits.after: - Talon vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment. - Stand where the rake's return doubles — geometry is the poke. - Engage only on Subject: Torment’s 12s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on kill windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Assassin's Path like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Hwei Subject: Torment: 12s at rank 1 — all his crowd control lives on this palette; dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. - Subject: Serenity is 18s: no shield and no escape while it's down. - Spiraling Despair is 120s; your R (100s) goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Fear (CC Paints) and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with W passes and stay relevant through roam tempo.
edits.after: If Hwei gets one kill, respect Subject: Torment doubly and reset to farming. Two kills: play for the team, not for solo redemption — farm with W passes and stay relevant through roam tempo.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: His combo needs two casts to prime the signature — W his first wind-up, Q in, and break the line before the second lands.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment — that is your 12-second full-commit window.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: An uncrashed wave bounces back while you roam — you return a plate down and he free-scales in peace.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his crowd control lives on the E palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Hwei’s Subject: Torment: all his crowd control lives on this palette — dodge the fear/root and the burst never chains. The whole green-light system is its 12s cooldown.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Bait the answer, then sign.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your jungler’s setup. Bait the answer, then sign.

edits.before: Shadow Assassin (R) turns you invisible and closes the gap Hwei relies on; if his EW (Stirring Lights) shield or QW (Fleeting Current) displacement is down, ult in, W-Q, and he simply dies before he can chain a combo.
edits.after: Shadow Assault (R) turns you invisible and closes the gap Hwei relies on; if his WW (Pool of Reflection) shield or WQ (Fleeting Current) dash is down, ult in, W-Q, and he simply dies before he can chain a combo.

notes: Fabricated 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' also survives in report[1].t and report[3].t — the two-report-entry rewrite cap was already spent on report[5]/report[9] (both name the fabrication), so those two are left for a follow-up pass; exact strings are in currentText. Sub-ability combo names in spikes/wants (Severing Bolt, Molten Fissure, Crushing Maelstrom, Stirring Lights, 'QW knock-up') are below the kit's resolution — the kit only names palette abilities — so I corrected spikes[1] to the widely-documented W-palette names (Pool of Reflection shield, Fleeting Current dash) and left the rest; listed in unverified.
